data.title: Iran Says It’s No Longer Bound by the Nuclear Treaty. What That Does to Oil, Gold, and Bitcoin
data.description: An Iranian lawmaker declared the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty no longer binding, oil surged, gold fell, and Bitcoin slipped below $78,000. Tracing whether a single committee member's words can actually travel from Tehran to your crypto wallet reveals a surprisingly fragile chain of dominoes.
data.keywords: Bitcoin, Tehran, Iran, Iranian Foreign Ministry, Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, Iran
